chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from al-Husayn ibn Hashim, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever believes in Allah and reads His Book does not neglect the recitation of the Surah 'Inna Arsalna Nuh'an ila Qawmihi'. So, any servant who recites it with expectation of reward, being patient, in an obligatory or recommended prayer, Allah will house him in the dwellings of the virtuous, and give him three gardens along with his own garden as a favor from Allah, and marry him to two hundred Hur al-'Ayn and four thousand other women, if Allah wills.

key_terms.الثَّيِّبِ: Other women (specifically those who were previously married)

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards for reciting Surah Nuh in prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the spiritual merit of consistently reciting Surah Nuh, linking the narrative of Noah’s patience with the believer's own endurance in obligatory and voluntary acts of worship. This practice is promised to elevate the reciter to the stations of the righteous, granting them three additional gardens and a multitude of spouses as a divine honor.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from al-Hussain b. Hashim from his father from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:

Whoever has belief and firm conviction on Allah should not miss recitation of “Inna Arsalna Noohan ilaa Qaumeh” (i.e. Surah Nuh) because whoever recites Surah Nuh in his obligatory and recommended prayer, Allah would allow him to stay with the virtuous and approved persons of Allah and would award him three gardens of Paradise with his garden by His special favors. He would marry the reciter to two hundred Hoorul Ein and four thousand other women.
